exposure: NLR (neutrophil/lymphocyte) values in all three trimesters
cohort: The study included 82 cases of pregnancies with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) delivered after 32 weeks.
finding: 3rd-trimester NLR showed a statistically significant association with the requirement for positive pressure ventilation and a notable association with Apgar Score <7 and the requirement for mechanical ventilation, while SII and PIV values did not consistently correlate with adverse neonatal outcomes.
